messages.subject: Rhipe Tutorial
parts:
Hi Saptarishi,
Lot of new users are asking for Rhipe tutorial starting from their
installation and how to use them for solving their problems. As you
have seen there are lot of users who find difficult to install Rhipe
first of all. One reason is that the information is not centralized.
Moreover i personally feel that we must present the usage of Rhipe by
solving some basic problem like wordcount, grep etc and then we can
start unfolding the complexity step by step,so that they don't loose
their interest.

Well i have prepared some tutorial on Rhipe which you can find here
http://groups.google.com/group/brumail/browse_thread/thread/e403db404f039e31
.

If you have the time, please go through the posts and suggest how it
can be improved.
Thank you very much.

Regards,
Som Shekhar
